worktree_sha.description: The PM-MCP-native working-tree digest, or 'unavailable' when a git invocation failed (job-runtime.adoc, Working-Tree Hash, rule 5); an 'unavailable' row never satisfies a freshness gate and never equals another 'unavailable'.

worktree_sha_version.description: Hash version of worktree_sha (job-runtime.adoc, Working-Tree Hash, rule 4); a change of the git invocation or framing is a new version, and freshness gates compare only equal versions.

worktree_sha_failure.description: Non-null exactly when worktree_sha == 'unavailable' (allOf above): the failing git command (argument vector) and how it failed.

gate_kind.description: The gate the row proves, one closed set with baseline.gate_kind: the canonical build verb of a local gate (job-runtime.adoc, Canonical Build Verb Set; never clean, install, clean-install, package, or benchmark) or ci_check:<name> for a CI check; null for a row that proves no gate. Read by the freshness gate (job-runtime.adoc, Gate Honesty Verification).

change_origin.description: For kind == 'change': quality_gate_autofix marks commits produced by a quality gate's auto-fix; footprint reconciliation reports those paths separately from deliverable changes.

expect.description: For kind == 'build': the pm_build expect parameter. A failed run with expect == 'red' is expected_red (no finding); a succeeded run with expect == 'red' is expected_red_went_green (recorded in expect_result); an expect == 'red' row never satisfies a freshness gate (mcp-tools.adoc, pm_build).

expect_result.description: For kind == 'build' with expect == 'red': expected_red when the run failed (the result's expectation: met), expected_red_went_green when it succeeded (expectation: violated); null otherwise.

criterion.description: For kind == 'build' with expect == 'red': the pm_build criterion parameter, the fix criterion this run proves red (Phase Workflows, Fix Proof Guard); null otherwise.

red_tests.description: For a build row with a criterion: the test files the worktree changed against base_ref at this run; null otherwise.

baseline.description: Required (non-null) iff kind == 'baseline_red'; null otherwise. The server's proof that a red gate at this worktree_sha is red only through failures already present on the base (Job Runtime, Baseline Separation).

gate_kind.description: The red gate, in the closed set of the row's gate_kind.

base_commit.description: The base commit whose result proved the failures: the merge base, or the latest base-branch commit containing it that has a provider result.

proof_source.description: ci_base_result: the provider's CI result of the same check on base_commit (primary); local_merge_base_build: a build of the merge base in the baseline scratch worktree (fallback for local gates or when the provider has no result for the base).

diagnostics_digest.description: SHA-256 over the sorted failure fingerprints accepted as baseline-only.

task_id.description: Required for kind == 'task_diff'; written only by the submit:TASK-NNN verification.
